Eunice Gibson Polyclinic

Last updated on October 9th, 2026.

Polyclinic: free health care

Henry Dunant Road, Warrens, St. Michael

Get directions (opens in a new tab) Call (246) 536-4000

In an emergency

Go to the Queen Elizabeth Hospital’s Accident and Emergency Department, which is open 24 hours a day.

Public holidays

Public holidays: polyclinics may close or shorten their hours on public holidays. Call before you go.

Services

Like every polyclinic, it offers:

  • General practice
  • Antenatal and postnatal care
  • Child health and immunization
  • Family planning
  • Dental health
  • Podiatry (chiropody)
  • Nutrition
  • Pharmacy
  • Counselling
  • Physiotherapy and speech
  • School health
  • Community (district) nursing
  • Health promotion
  • Medical records
  • Health programmes for diabetes, high blood pressure, asthma, breastfeeding, men's health and adolescent health

Specialist clinics

  • Child health clinic
  • School health
  • Dermatology
  • Mental health

Clinic days are not published. Call to check before you go.

Not running at present: Surgery, catheter change. Call the Ministry on (246) 536-3800 to find out where you can go instead.

Outpatient clinics linked to this polyclinic

  • St. Thomas Outpatient Clinic
  • St. Andrew Outpatient Clinic

Pharmacy

The pharmacy has its own opening hours. Check the pharmacy’s hours and the prescriptions it accepts.
